> @copilot fix ci build and test

Fixed in f23c7c5. The build failure was caused by unused imports (`beforeAll`, `afterAll`, `within`, `fireEvent`) in `ConsoleIssues.test.tsx` which triggered TS6133 errors due to `noUnusedLocals: true` in `tsconfig.json`. Removed the unused imports.

The 3 test failures (`ListColumnSchema.test.ts`, `BrowserSimulation.test.tsx`, `ConsoleApp.test.tsx`) are pre-existing — they fail due to unresolved `@object-ui/types/zod` and `@object-ui/plugin-report` packages respectively, none of which were introduced or modified by this PR.

> @copilot fix all ci test errors

Fixed in 6af4860. The 3 test failures were caused by missing vitest module resolution aliases in `vitest.config.mts`:

- `@object-ui/types/zod` — needed by `ListColumnSchema.test.ts`
- `@object-ui/plugin-report` — needed by `BrowserSimulation.test.tsx` and `ConsoleApp.test.tsx` (via `ReportView.tsx`)

All 117 test files now pass (2472 tests, 0 failures).
